extraction.method: Verbatim manual transcription from the session transcript via the write_file tool; content boundaries fixed by convention below; no normalization, no reflow, no re-typing from memory, no substitution of superseding text into earlier documents.
extraction.boundary_convention: Each revN document = its Markdown H1 title line through its final status line, inclusive. Conversational preambles preceding the H1 are excluded and are not part of any document. rev4_extract.md = Rev 4 sections 2.2.2 and 3.1-3.3 only, verbatim, contiguous, original headings preserved (the Rev 4 section-3 preamble paragraph before heading 3.1 is outside the required range and excluded).
extraction.as_emitted_rule: Extracted files are frozen as-emitted: known-later corrections (e.g., V3/V4 alternate bytes 06 67 00 0C -> 06 66 70 0C) are NOT retro-applied; they live in the superseding errata files, all of which are included. The corpus is consumed in supersession order.
extraction.trailing_newline: Each extracted file is terminated by a single trailing newline (convention of the write_file tool).
